q: The continued fraction expansion connects to hyperbolic geometry via the modular surface. Periodic continued fractions correspond to:
opts: Quadratic irrationals (real roots of quadratic equations with integer coefficients)
exp: Periodic continued fractions ↔ quadratic irrationals (Lagrange's theorem): α has a periodic CF expansion iff α is a root of a quadratic with integer coefficients (irrational root). Under the geodesic flow on the modular surface SL(2,ℤ)\ℍ, the periodic CF corresponds to closed geodesics.
